verdict.rationale: Scoped or least-privilege API credentials are a fair question for an API platform like Lithic, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents API keys with restricted permissions or scopes. Card-level authorization rules, spend limits, and per-card controls ([lithic-docs-3], [lithic-docs-13], [lithic-docs-11]) restrict what a card can spend, not what an API credential can do. Those are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.
